title: SELECTEDVALUE returns the only visible value of the column, also when the filter is on another column
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( Product[Color] ), Product[Product] = "Lock" ) )

source.quote: An equivalent expression for SELECTEDVALUE(<columnName>, <alternateResult>) is IF(HASONEVALUE(<columnName>), VALUES(<columnName>), <alternateResult>) .
source.supports: SELECTEDVALUE returns the value when the column has one visible value, else the alternate

derivation: The filter leaves one Product row, Lock, whose color is Blue. Product[Color] has one visible value, which is returned.
